decision.hypothesis: H3: replacing the global-tau shrinkage with a per-pair decision that uses the estimator's OWN variance recovers the low-sigma cells without giving up the high-sigma wins
decision.order: the brief's order -- hard abstain, then per-pair shrinkage, then both -- is part of the rule: the FIRST arm satisfying every validation clause is the one that ships, so a better-scoring arm later in the order does not displace it
